hooks.command: bash -c 'REPO=/tmp/lifvra-claude-tooling; if [ -d "$REPO/.git" ]; then git -C "$REPO" pull --depth 1 -q 2>/dev/null; else GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Lifvra/claude-tooling "$REPO" 2>/dev/null; fi; cp "$REPO/scripts/session-start-plugins.sh" ~/.claude/session-start-plugins.sh 2>/dev/null; cp "$REPO/scripts/test-plugins.sh" ~/.claude/test-plugins.sh 2>/dev/null; chmod +x ~/.claude/session-start-plugins.sh ~/.claude/test-plugins.sh 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$REPO/skills/"* ~/.claude/skills/ 2>/dev/null; ~/.claude/session-start-plugins.sh 2>&1 || true'
